findings: `meaning_history.senses[0].status` and its generated `has_sense` relationship should remain `historical`. The dossier documents a bronze inscription using 大 for “big,” but does not establish that this is the earliest attestation: it says the vessel/date and primary inscription were not independently verified, and records other oracle-bone uses without assigning their meaning or proving priority (X-6159f6ab0334b15a4d20, X-30f633eacef2d6b6d523, X-2be697f5af6f954aa1f1, X-611bc5fd1a46d63bc607).
